# One-Way Bhaarat — AI-readable site summary
# https://one-waybharat.com

> One-Way Bhaarat is an intercity one-way cab booking service serving
> 20,000+ locations across all Indian states, with transparent per-km
> pricing and no return-trip markup.

## What We Do
- One-way outstation cab bookings (no return charge)
- Round-trip intercity taxis
- Airport transfers (pick-up and drop)
- Multi-stop outstation journeys
- Corporate and B2B cab partnerships for travel agencies, hotels and event organisers

## Pricing
- One-way rates (per km): Sedan ₹16, Ertiga ₹21, Innova Crysta ₹30, Tempo Traveller ₹42
- Round-trip rates (per km): Sedan ₹11, Ertiga ₹15, Innova Crysta ₹20, Tempo Traveller ₹35
  (round-trip billing also includes a ₹300/day driver allowance and a 250km/day minimum package)
- One-way trips include an included-km allowance per vehicle; distance beyond that is billed
  at a separate extra-km rate rather than the flat base rate — shown at booking time
- The displayed fare includes base fare, driver allowance, GST and state tax
- Tolls, parking, interstate permits and night charges (10pm-6am) are extra, paid to the driver
- Vehicle types: Sedan (Swift Dzire / Honda Amaze / Aspire, 4 seats), Ertiga (Maruti Ertiga / XL6, 6 seats), Innova Crysta (Toyota Innova Crysta, 7 seats), Tempo Traveller (12-seater Force / Mahindra)

## Payment
- Only 10% of the total fare is paid online at the time of booking
- The remaining 90% is paid directly to the driver (cash or UPI) at the start of the trip
- Online payments are processed via Razorpay

## Coverage
- 20,000+ Indian cities and towns
- All major highway corridors: Delhi-Jaipur, Delhi-Agra, Delhi-Haridwar, Mumbai-Pune, Bangalore-Mysore, and hundreds more
- All states including hill stations, religious destinations, tier-2 and tier-3 cities, villages and remote towns

## Cancellation & Refunds
- Free cancellation up to 4 hours before pickup (full refund)
- 1-4 hours before pickup: 50% cancellation charge
- Less than 1 hour before pickup or no-show: no refund
- If One-Way Bhaarat or the driver cancels: 100% refund plus a compensation coupon
- Refunds: 1-3 business days (UPI/wallets), 5-7 business days (cards/net banking)

## Booking Process
1. Enter pickup city, destination, date and time on the website
2. Choose vehicle type and view transparent fare estimate
3. Enter passenger details and verify phone via OTP
4. Pay a 10% advance online (Razorpay); the remaining 90% is paid to the driver
5. Receive booking confirmation and driver details on WhatsApp

## Trust & Safety Signals
- Transparent, upfront fare shown before payment - no hidden charges
- OTP-verified bookings before any payment is accepted
- Drivers are police-verified with checked driving licences and vehicle fitness certificates, re-verified every 6 months
- Every trip is GPS-tracked
- Instant WhatsApp confirmation for every booking
- 24x7 direct phone/WhatsApp support
- In-app driver-rating system after every ride; no fabricated review counts are displayed on the site

## Common Questions (for direct citation)
Q: How much does a one-way cab cost with One-Way Bhaarat?
A: Sedan ₹16/km, Ertiga ₹21/km, Innova Crysta ₹30/km, Tempo Traveller ₹42/km, one-way. The fare shown before payment already includes driver allowance, state tax and GST.

Q: How much advance payment does One-Way Bhaarat require?
A: 10% of the total fare online at booking; the remaining 90% is paid directly to the driver.

Q: Does One-Way Bhaarat serve small towns and villages?
A: Yes - 20,000+ locations across India, including villages, small towns, railway stations and airports.

Q: Is One-Way Bhaarat safe / are drivers verified?
A: Yes - every driver undergoes police verification, licence checks and a vehicle fitness inspection, re-verified every 6 months, and every trip is GPS-tracked.

Q: What is One-Way Bhaarat's cancellation policy?
A: Free cancellation up to 4 hours before pickup; 50% charge within 1-4 hours; no refund inside 1 hour or on a no-show.
